New Upgrade Consoles added to outposts. Players can now access most of the features of the game from the outpoints without docking stations.

The AI of the Fly-type ships has been improved and fixed the performance issues when fighting with the fly swarm.

The following bugs are fixed;
([i] reported by players as follows[/i]):

•	Swapping slots in Cargohold causes incorrect stats to be displayed on the detail interface.

•	The game crashes at the Wormhole bonus stage if my cargo hold is full.

•	Trade ships scale 10x bigger when selling ships at stations. 

•	Laser bullets damage is equal to turret bullets but projectile speed is lower. 

•	When I switch to the new map, the speed progress bar appears in full. This problem persists until you change the ship mode.

•	In tutorial missions, there is an empty square on the ship perk slot, and the perk is not available. (Perk's not being available has to do with the design of the mission. Perk will become available later in the tutorial task.)

•	Another character model is sitting in the cockpit of the chark model ship in sandbox mode. 

•	When a skill is disabled, a black square appears on the skill slot at new HUD. 

•	I can’t remap the Mouse buttons if I talk with someone on stations. ( We were unable to reproduce this bug. But we think that such a problem will not occur anymore with the new functions we added to the end of the dialogs.)

•	When I try to transport drag containers by non-trade ships, it says overweight even though there is room in my cargo.

•	Skipping the 2nd tutorial mission opens the same level from start.

notes.title: SPACEBOURNE VERSION 1.0
notes.content:
[b]SpaceBourne is exiting early access.[/b]

In our about 2 years of long early access adventure, we added numerous new features to the game with 51 updates that were requested by our community.

For the last 3 weeks, 4 players play tested SpaceBourne for more than 300 hours and we fixed any bugs that they encountered.

However, the full version of our game does not mean that we will stop improving the game. Spacebourne will grow more and more with your feedback and reports.


[b]Improvements and Changes:[/b]

• System scan has been changed. System scanning is now made using only the Scan button. Also, the scanning range has been removed from the game.

• The interaction system with NPCs and other objects at the stations has been reinvented/improved.
• All in-game sounds and music are reclassified and organized.

• All Looking for Pilot missions are balanced 

• All side missions from stations generals are balanced

• All Main story missions are balanced

• Crafting is balanced and added new crafting blueprints

[u]Here is the list of bugs that were fixed:[/u]

( [i]reported by players as follows[/i]):

• Wormhole bosses escape from portal even If I destroy engines.

• I can take Health visitor missions from the start after I complete all chain.

• When you close the game with Alt + F4 while in the Trade tutorial, all the save names become “Trade Tutorial Save”

• While crafting, the raw materials in some crafting blueprints change while crafting. If the cargo has more than necessary raw materials, it consumes 1 more item than the recipe requires.

• If I switch to screenshot mode while crafting, the crafting interface freezes, and I’m forced to quit the game with Alt + F4

NOTES:

•	Some control settings have been changed in the game. If you encounter any errors while controlling the ship, please try to reset the controls with the "Reset to Default" button on the settings page.

Endless thanks to all our early access players for your support in this process.

notes.title: LAST MAJOR UPDATE BEFORE FULL RELEASE
notes.content:
Greetings;

We formed a small team of experienced SpaceBourne players. We’ll be solely focusing on finishing up the game and exiting Early Access. We will work to perfect the game's main story mode, then the sandbox mode, so they both feel balanced and polished from start to finish.

After completing the two main gameplay modes, we will work on all other side events (Crafting- trading- bounties – Mining – Salvaging- Wars and game mechanics) and release a final major update.

If it all goes well, we’ll be exiting early access within 3-4 weeks.

Thank you for supporting us through this process.

Stay safe.

notes.title: Early Access Version 1.3.6 Released
notes.content:
[h1][b]Early Access Version 1.3.6 [/b][/h1]

[h1][b]New Feature: Dynamic Newspaper[/b][/h1]

• Players can now follow events in the galaxy from the new News Panel.
• Now, as well as diplomatic news and trade news, the player's missions and their impact will also be included in the news interface.

[h1][b]New Feature: Bounty on Player:[/b]
[/h1]
• Now, as a result of the decisions made by the players and the pirate missions they complete, NPCs can put a reward on the player's head.
• New NPC: “Informer” added at every pirate station.
• Informers are those who determine the locations of the people you are hunting in the galaxy. Once the player has bounty on his/her head, they can pay informers to locate the contract holder. Player can override contracts by finding and eliminating contract owners. 
• “Bounty pay off” panel has beed added to the outposts interfaces. Players can pay off the bounties with using this panel.
• New ships: Bounty hunters
• Bounty hunters can perform surprise attacks against the player if the player has a bounty on his/her head.

[h1][b]New Difficulty Options:[/b][/h1]

New difficulty options have been added to the game upon incoming requests. These options include:
Random pirate attacks, bounty hunter attacks and battles can be disabled.
• In addition, the damage dealt by the AI to the player, the damage dealt by the player to the AI, the maneuverability of AI ships and the accuracy of AI ships can be adjusted by the player.
• Note: These options are currently in beta, please report any bugs that may arise from playing with these options.

[h1][b]New Weapon Tier: Legendary Weapons:
[/b][/h1]

• More than 60 legendary weapons have been added to the game. These weapons are not sold by merchants. They only drops from certain missions and certain bosses.

[h1][b]Interface Improvements;[/b][/h1]

• Character interface has been Improved.
• Log and notes interfaces removed from the game
• News interface has been improved and made more interactive
• All tutorial interfaces have been changed and gamepad keys have been added to the tutorials that contain the keyboard keys.
• 6 new tutorial interfaces have been added.

[h1][b] Features Added / Changed :
[/b][/h1]

• A reward system added to battles. Now, according to the player's performance in battles, money, rare items, very rare items and legendary war hero weapons can be given to the player as reward. These prizes are awarded only if the player is the winner of the battle.
• A new 9 stage quest line has been added to the game. Both for story and sandbox modes.
• Randomly generated wormhole bosses are added to the game. At the end of each wormhole, different bosses are now waiting for the player.
• Drops of Wormhole bosses are arranged. Now the wormhole bosses drop legendary weapons.
• Lerisa mission changed. The Lerisa Spider Tank mission was removed. Instead, a more challenging battle in orbit of the planet has been added to the game.
• The task of surface cleaning has been changed. The drone landing part has been entirely removed. Instead, a combat mission in space has been added to the game.
• First Person camera added to the character on stations. The player can switch to the first person camera at the station by pressing the “C ”key.
• “Continue” button has been added to game intro screen. Now players can continue the game without entering the main menu.
• Anomaly core values increased
• The startup speed of the game was accelerated by 300%
• Pirate ambushes and pirate surprise attacks added to the game
• Certain minor bugs and errors have been fixed.
• Certain English Translation, spelling and grammar errors fixed

[b]MAJOR FEATURES:

[b]CRAFTING[/b]

•	Players will be able to hire soldiers and pilots from their strategy center once it is installed.
•	These soldiers can be given orders such as defending the station or fighting alongside missions.
•	An internal economic system has been added for stations. Income is collected by renting parts of the station and collecting tax from the residents of the station.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g5K6yzAnGsQ

[b]MAJOR GAMEPLAY FEATURES: [/b]
[b]

Looking for Pilot Panel: 
[/b]

In accordance with the community feedback, “Mission System Improvements” are added to the game.

[*] Starter ship is changed. You will realize that the B35 starter ship is changed to an Anromeda model. Early Access players will be able to purchase the B35 from ship dealers for 1.ooo TY. Those of you happy with the B35 will be able to purchase it with ease. 
[*] Switching between piloting modes is changed. Switching animation and effects are removed. You can now switch between modes instantaneously. 
[*] 3 new ship cockpits are added.
[*] Warp times are shortened. New effects are added for short distance warps. 
[/list]

[u][b]4-Gamepad and Joystick Support :[/b][/u]

Again in accordance with our Early Access player feedback full gamepad and joystick + HOTAS Suppot is added.

[list]
[*] With the new keybinding and control systems Gamepad and Joystick peformance is increased.
[*] A new advanced settings menus is added for Gamepads and Joysticks. Using thie menu you can change: Axis sensitivity, Deadzone, and also set your + / - axes.
[*] Pedal sensitivity setting is added for pedal users.
[*] Using advanced settings you can change button bindings. [u]Careful[/u]: This is different from the keybinding settings. This setting is for switching 2 buttons with each other. For example: when X and Y buttons are switched, pressing X on the Gamepad will act like pressing Y. This settings is added for multi-button joystick and Hotas users
[/list]

[u][b]5-New Physics Engine :[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] SpaceBourne’s physics engine is changed.
[*] FPS limit is increased to 60.
[*] Crashing and impact mechanics are added.
[*] Space objects can now drift and move.
[/list]

[u][b]6-Performance and Visuals :[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Lighting is improved and model details are optimized, increasing the overall performance by 35 - 45 %. 
[*] Post-process data is improved. Stations are now more performant and visually appealing. 
[*] Level load times are shorter.
[*] Audio channels are optimized. Audio quality setting is added to the Options Menu.
[*] All planet and satellite models are replaced with more realistic ones.
[*]Space atmosphere is improved. Space and solar systems are now more realistic. A more realistic space lighting is achieved through new light calculations that take into account the the position of the sun and the distance between the player and the sun. 

[/list]

[u][b]Other Additions :[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Item market values are changed.
[*] Tutorial map is changed. Tutorial mission now includes ship perks training.
[*] Main Menu and Settings are changed.
[*] 8 new weapons are added.
[*] Some of the in-game UI is improved. The rest of the UI will be improved in the coming updates.
[*] Mining NPC ships are added to asteroid fields.
[*] Randomly appearing pirate attacks and pirate raids are added.
[*]Wormhole maps are improved.
[*]3 new enemy ships are added. 2 frigates and 1 fly class. 
[*]Space Anamolys are redesigned. Gathering Space Anomolies are now more challenging.
[*]The salvaged materials collected from the new Space Anamolies can now be used to increase crafted weapon quality.
[*]Improvements to the artificial intelligence are made. Artificial intelligence now acts taking into account its tactical advantages. AI can now develop different strategies taking the possibility of winning / losing the war into account.
[*]And more than 50 minor changes. 

[/list]

Thanks for your support and feedbacks in the Early Access process.

notes.title: Additional Features Poll Announcement
notes.content:
[b]First of all I would like to thank you all for your interest in our game during the Early Access phase: SpaceBourne is getting better each day with your support and feedback. [/b]

Each day we are getting less and less bug reports. We hope to eliminate all the bugs reported till today with the major patch that is planned to be released tomorrow. We are confident that we will make SpaceBourne playable without any major bugs in a very short time period. Even now there are players who have already completed the main story and started a new game.

As we are progressing on eliminating the bugs you have reported, we also would like to get your opinion about the new features that you would like to be added to the game:

At this point we categorized new features under 3 sections: Major, Intermediate, Minor Features.

[b]All the Major and Intermadiate Feates would be probably be avilable only with the full release of the game therefor pick the ones that suits best to your gaming style.[/b]

[u]All the minor ones will be added during the Early Access phase so pick the one you would like to see first.[/u]

[h1]MAJOR FEATURES:[/h1]

[b]CRAFTING[/b]
This feature will ad a Crafting System to the game. Player will be able to craft new items, trade them and use them on their ship with the raw materials gathered from mining and salvaging. 

[b]THIRD PERSON SHOOTER[/b]
This Feature will enable the player to fight himself. Use weapons, raid planets and bases. 

[b]COMMAND CENTER[/b]
This feature adds: Controlling your army, training your soldiers and leveling them up, giving orders during the space fights and sending soldiers to missions you choose.

[b]CAPITAL SHIP WARS: [/b]
Enables player to fly capital ships and engage battles with them.

[h1]INTERMEDIATE FEATURES[/h1]

[b]STATION IMPROVEMENT [/b]
Those are planned to be added under this title: 
•	More active NPCs added to the current stations,
•	Adding completely new stations, 
•	Athmosphere improvement to the current stations

[b]MISSION SYSTEM IMPROVEMENT [/b]
This feature includes the following:
•	New side missions,
•	A new in-game mission panel that is updated concurrently during gameplay with new missions,
•	Player will be able to receive and complete new missions by just using the new panel.

[b]TRADE IMPROVEMENT: [/b]
This feature includes the following:
•	A brand new trade system,
•	Simultaneously changing market values with supply / demand
•	Player will be able to trade with huge cargo ships

[b]LIVING GALAXY FEATURE [/b]
With this feature galaxy will feel a lot more lively, 
New NPCs added that goes on missions, trading, fighting wars other than the Player. Player will be able to interact with those new NPCs.

[b]SANDBOX GAME MODE[/b]
Player will be able to roam and do anything freely without the main mission. 

[h1]MINOR FEATURES:[/h1]
[olist]
 [*]Full Joystick and controller support
 [*]FPS limist increased from 35 to 60
[*]Addition of new ships and revamp the properties of current ships.
[*]New weapons and upgrades
 [*]Graphical improvements, better athmosphere, visual improvements to battles and stations.
[*]When starting a new game option to chose the stage of training mission (Basic, advanced) 
[*]Improvements to the UI 
[/olist]

please share your suggestions with us on the community page;

https://steamcommunity.com/app/732240/discussions/0/1730963192556105962/

Thank you.

notes.title: Early Access Release Announcement
notes.content:
Hi everyone;

Today is the Early Access release day of SpaceBourne. We thank you for following and supporting SpaceBourne during its development. 

[b]SpaceBorune’s expected release time is GMT+3 18:00. [/b]

We suggest you check out the notes about Early Access Version of the game.
Our regards.

[u][b]SpaceBourne Early Access V.1.01 Notes:[/b][/u]

- We had to (temporarily) remove joystick and controller support from the game’s listed features on the Store Page after Steam’s inspection of SpaceBourne. Possible problems for joystick users, in this version, are as follows:

•	Controllers and joysticks plugged in after the game started may not be detected. Controllers need to be connected before launching the game so Windows can detect them.

•	Disconnecting joysticks might cause problems in Keyboard+Mouse control. Restarting the game after disconnecting is suggested.

•	Assigning buttons to the joystick is removed. In this version Joysticks will work only with default settings.

Steam wouldn’t allow us to release the game without solving these problems but we are releasing the game with limited Joystick support so we don’t keep you waiting. [b][u]I should note that, these problems will be taken care of with a patch in the coming weeks.[/u][/b] If you would like to play the game with Joystick or Gamepad, we suggest waiting for the next patch for a better playing experience.

Have fun, see you in space : )
